rationale: This draft records a research question without selecting favorable thresholds or authorizing evaluation.
target_population: Frozen V0.1.1 attention-momentum candidates in a future explicitly approved historical research sample.
observation_window: UNRESOLVED pending source-coverage and licensing review.

minimum_sample_size.rationale: No sample threshold will be chosen before source coverage is understood.

decision_thresholds.rationale: Thresholds require prospective preregistration after feasibility work.

promotion_criteria.rationale: No promotion rule is justified at the infrastructure stage.

rejection_criteria.rationale: No rejection rule is justified at the infrastructure stage.

stop_conditions.rationale: Operational and licensing stop conditions require future review.

multiple_testing_family: V0.1.2 catalyst experiments A-C; correction method UNRESOLVED.
leakage_risks: Catalyst records arriving after a signal could be joined retrospectively.
Duplicate stories could be counted as independent evidence.
known_limitations: Vendor coverage and first-seen timestamps are not yet characterized.
Catalyst labels are observational and may be subjective.
No causal claim or performance improvement is established.
notes: Draft only. Evaluation commands are intentionally unavailable.
hypothesis: Momentum candidates associated with a fresh, company-specific, material catalyst behave differently from candidates without an identifiable catalyst.
comparison_group: Candidates without an identifiable point-in-time catalyst under the same future coverage rules.

feature_definitions.name: fresh_catalyst_present
feature_definitions.definition: Whether at least one qualifying catalyst was first seen within an unresolved pre-signal freshness interval.
feature_definitions.availability_time: Uses only records first seen at or before the candidate signal timestamp.

feature_definitions.name: company_specific_material
feature_definitions.definition: Whether the observation is company-specific and material under future preregistered ordinal rules.
feature_definitions.availability_time: Uses only source and parser information available at or before the signal timestamp.
